answer: Agents secure identity by reserving 1,000 slots of compute capacity at a registrar, as parallel waiting alone fails to block identity pooling. Each agent must occupy a tundra of reserved time to prove activity; a verifier tracks the pulse of incoming heartbeats to ensure exclusive occupancy. An opal of a session token serves as evidence, revoked upon overlap. Honest nodes pay once; 1,000 fakes incur terminal lock forfeiture and removal.
